description: This file defines the GrafanaClient class, which provides a thin wrapper around the Grafana REST API, enabling operations such as searching dashboards, managing data sources, alert rules, and users. It includes methods for CRUD operations and handles API responses, including error handling.

classes.name: GrafanaClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with Grafana's REST API, supporting dashboards, data sources, alerts, and user management.

classes.name: GrafanaClient.NotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a requested resource is not found in Grafana API.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the GrafanaClient with base URL, headers, and an HTTP client.

methods.name: __del__(self)
methods.description: Ensures proper cleanup of the HTTP client upon object deletion.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search_dashboards(self, query: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Searches dashboards in Grafana, optionally filtering by query string.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_dashboard(self, uid: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dashboard by its UID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_or_update_dashboard(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates or updates a dashboard in Grafana.

methods.name: None delete_dashboard(self, uid: str)
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard by UID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_datasources(self)
methods.description: Lists all data sources in Grafana.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_datasource(self, id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a data source by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_datasource(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new data source.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_datasource(self, id: int, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing data source.

methods.name: None delete_datasource(self, id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a data source by ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_alert_rules(self)
methods.description: Lists all alert rules.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_alert_rule(self, uid: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an alert rule by UID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_alert_rule(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new alert rule.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_alert_rule(self, uid: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing alert rule.

methods.name: None delete_alert_rule(self, uid: str)
methods.description: Deletes an alert rule by UID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_users(self)
methods.description: Lists all users.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by user ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_user(self, user_id: int, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing user.

methods.name: None delete_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a user by user ID.

methods.name: _handle_response(self, resp: httpx.Response)
methods.description: Handles HTTP responses, raising exceptions on errors and parsing JSON payloads.
